name: chad-review
description: 9-pass autonomous pre-commit code review skill. Runs structural, behavioral, spec-drift, test, test-coverage, observability, documentation, adversarial, and dependency-freshness analysis on uncommitted working-tree changes (or the last commit if clean). Diff-shape aware: docs-only, config-only, deps-only, and tiny diffs skip the sub-agent fan-out. Token-efficient: rote passes bundle into one mechanical agent per language (3 sub-agents, not 7), session-relative sonnet/opus/fable model tiering with no hardcoded parent pin, and a strict one-line-per-finding output contract. Read-only, never edits or commits.
